content: You will be given an argumentation and asked about to find the relation from relation types: sup (support), exa (support by example), add (additional source), reb (rebutting attack), und (undercutting attack), joint (joining relation) between two selected argument components from it.

Whenever Peter bumps into an ex-girlfriend at a party, he forgoes any further consumption of alcohol just in case. When he got back from Ralf's party last night he was still stone-cold sober. Thus one of his ex-girlfriends must have been there. Ralf does insist that they drank advocaat together. But even without an ex-girlfriend he would never touch that.
What is the relation between "When he got back from Ralf's party last night he was still stone-cold sober." and "But even without an ex-girlfriend he would never touch that." from the above essay? Choose from following options 1. reb
2. und
3. joint
4. exa
5. sup
6. no relation
